target_customer: Online creators and ecommerce sellers with contracted brand deals or platform payouts
problem: Creators wait 30 to 90 days to be paid by platforms and brands; Flowbo advanced funds against contracts and invoices with revenue share repayment.
business_model: Revenue based financing, fees stated as 1 to 4 percent in one place and 5 to 15 percent in another on the company site

founders.name: Daniel Kang
education: University of Oxford and McGill University, policy and finance (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page; board observer at Auto1 Group.

founders.name: Norman Yu
founders.background_notes: Listed on YC page with no background; no other source found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Underwriting from platform revenue APIs and contracts plus payments is standard fintech engineering with credit risk modeling as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Anyone with capital could offer creator advances; no data advantage or licence was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing incumbents acting on the wedge.

market_need_then: The creator economy was growing in 2021 and Product Hunt launch copy cites slow payment from brands and platforms; no spend data found.

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt on 2021-07-08; featured in an NEA podcast episode with Patreon.

brand_strength.rationale: Product Hunt launch and a venture firm podcast, but no wider brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Flowbo launched on Product Hunt in July 2021 and was in private beta with a waitlist on its site. The YC page lists it as inactive and Dealroom marks it closed, but the company site shows no shutdown notice and no post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public.
notes: The seed rests on a single database set (CB Insights, Extruct and Bouncewatch repeat 125K to 130K, likely the standard YC deal); no press confirmation. The site lists additional investors Jonas Templstein, HOF Capital and Unshackled Ventures. Exit type unknown because the YC status is Inactive but the site still shows a beta. No dated competitor source found (searches did not surface Pipe, Clearco or others for the period), so the list is empty.
